reports.speaker: Ailana Fraser
reports.title: Stability Theory for Minimal Surfaces
reports.outline_title: 极小曲面的稳定性与全纯刚性
reports.arxiv_version_role: Supplementary Fraser-Schoen primary research paper; NOT the version URL of the ICM report.
reports.copyright: 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM
reports.question: 稳定性的二阶面积约束为何在余维一迫使平坦，而在高余维导向全纯性；复法丛、覆盖和各向同性曲率又怎样把这一机制转化为大小与拓扑限制？
reports.reading_scope: Entire official SIAM mathematical body §§1-4 plus the complete versioned Fraser-Schoen 2303.07423v1 TeX §§1-5. Selected branches are integrated with worked calculations and precise external inputs; the full research proofs are not reconstructed.

proof_scope.2L01: Defines the pullback normal bundle and projected connection; derives the Weingarten pairing by differentiating orthogonality. Explicitly distinguishes vector B=-A nu and Hvector=-H nu from the site's scalar convention.
proof_scope.2L02: Derives the arbitrary-codimension real second variation from a normal geodesic variation and the determinant derivative. Defines stability and real Morse index for internally compactly supported normal variations; no free-boundary formula.
proof_scope.2L03: Calculates the complex-bilinear and first-variable-linear Hermitian extensions; proves the isotropic dimension bound and relates the null relation to conformality.
proof_scope.2L04: Koszul-Malgrange local existence is cited. In complex dimension one the integrability obstruction vanishes; metric compatibility explicitly proves holomorphic self-duality.
proof_scope.2L05: Euclidean complex second variation is derived in full from the real formula and integration by parts. The curved Micallef-Moore formula is cited, not claimed proved. Its curvature term is b(R(s,u_z)u_barz,bar s); the unit-sphere check gives lambda^2 |s|^2/2 and the negative sign in Q.
proof_scope.2L06: Defines general calibration and proves the compact homologous-chain volume comparison by Stokes, with multiplicities and compactly supported variations stated.
proof_scope.2L07: Computes comass, closedness and equality planes of a constant orthogonal complex structure; proves calibration of J-holomorphic curves.
proof_scope.2L08: Computes the induced metric, proves completeness using Cauchy sequences, exhibits a nonzero normal second derivative, and calculates curvature and total absolute curvature 2 pi.
proof_scope.2L09: Defines finite-cover stability and proves it for calibrated immersions by pullback of the calibration, retaining parameter-domain multiplicities.
proof_scope.2L0A: Proves finite-cover stability for two-sided hypersurfaces by the fiberwise sum of squares, its smooth square-root regularization, Schwarz and dominated convergence. Neither completeness nor compactness is assumed.
proof_scope.2L0B: States the finite-total-curvature compactification and smooth Gauss-map/normal-bundle extension as Osserman-Micallef inputs. Does not claim extension of the singular induced surface metric.
proof_scope.2L0C: Given the cited bundle extension, explicitly computes logarithmic cutoff energy and proves convergence of all terms in the compactified stability inequality. Covers of the compactification retain finitely many punctures.
proof_scope.2L0D: Birkhoff-Grothendieck splitting and uniqueness are cited. The O(a) section calculation, global generation for a>=0, and at-least-half-rank consequence of self-duality are proved.
proof_scope.2L0E: States Micallef's complete oriented genus-zero finite-total-curvature stability theorem. The proof overview links proved cutoff and section calculations, but the fixed ambient complex-subspace construction remains cited.
proof_scope.2L0F: States the Arezzo-Micallef-Pirola genus-two counterexample in R^(2m), m>=11; neither its construction nor stability proof is reproduced.
proof_scope.2L0G: Constructs the unitary flat quotient and derives its section equivariance. Proves absence of nonzero holomorphic sections for nontrivial monodromy. Realization of every degree-zero holomorphic line bundle as unitary flat is cited; analytic degree is locally defined by meromorphic zeros and poles.
proof_scope.2L0H: Constructs explicit unit sections on degree-k^2 covers, verifies both period transformations, and derives the C_tau/k derivative estimate after reducing each phase modulo 2 pi.
proof_scope.2L0I: Computes all holomorphic sections of the rank-two unipotent quotient and proves nonsplitting. Atiyah's identification/classification is cited with indecomposability retained.
proof_scope.2L0J: States the complete oriented finite-total-curvature genus-one cover-stable theorem. Atiyah filtration, uniformly controlled estimates and the fixed ambient complex-subspace step are research inputs; the narrative is explicitly a proof overview.
proof_scope.2L0K: Proves a conditional coercivity lemma with uniform upper and lower Gram bounds and small derivatives on finite covers. Does not assert the existence of such frames for arbitrary degree-zero bundles or replace the original filtration proof.
proof_scope.2L0L: Defines normalized complex sectional/PIC curvature, verifies basis independence and expands the real four-frame formula with the factor 1/4. Uses the standard first Bianchi identity and checks the space-form normalization.
proof_scope.2L0M: Derives a strict instability criterion for a nonzero compactly supported isotropic complex normal section from the cited curved second-variation formula, with all conformal factors and the conversion to a real negative variation explicit.
proof_scope.2L0N: Works out RP^3 x S^1: PIC>=1/2 by projection and Bessel, stability of the product torus by shortest-loop length and the sliced index form, and a negative constant-normal direction on its double cover.
proof_scope.2L0O: States the unbranched immersion specialization of Fraser-Schoen's stable-torus systole bound with a universal constant. Does not import numerical constants from differing curvature conventions or reproduce the intrinsic-distance/normal-bundle estimates.
proof_scope.2L0P: States the Micallef-Moore area-index bound floor((n-2)/2) for minimal immersed two-spheres in PIC. The construction of a negative-definite subspace is cited, not inferred from independent individual negative vectors.
proof_scope.2L0Q: Proves closed two-sided Ricci-nonnegative rigidity with f=1; proves nonexistence under positive Ricci. Closedness and two-sidedness are essential to the test field.
proof_scope.2L0R: States the no-Z^2 subgroup theorem for closed PIC manifolds of dimension >=4, using the report and Fraser-Schoen formulation for the full dimension range. Minimal-map existence, branch handling and group-to-size arguments are not reconstructed.

claim_sources.2L07: SIAM §3.1, Definition 3.4 and holomorphic area-minimizing discussion
claim_sources.2L08: SIAM §3.1 calibration principle; explicit parabola calculation developed here
claim_sources.2L0A: SIAM property 1 after Definition 3.13; fiber-square proof developed here
claim_sources.2L0B: SIAM §3.4; Fraser-Schoen v1 §2.1; its citations to Osserman and Micallef p.80
claim_sources.2L0D: SIAM §3.4, Birkhoff-Grothendieck splitting and genus-zero argument
claim_sources.2L0I: SIAM §3.5.1; Fraser-Schoen v1 §3.1, Atiyah bundle model
claim_sources.2L0J: SIAM Theorem 3.14 and §3.5.3; Fraser-Schoen v1 Theorems 3.6-3.7 and 4.2, Proposition 4.1
claim_sources.2L0K: SIAM §3.5.3 and Fraser-Schoen v1 Theorem 3.7 motivate this separately stated conditional lemma
claim_sources.2L0L: SIAM §4 Definitions 4.1-4.3 and 4.8, equation (4.1), with explicit normalization correction
claim_sources.2L0M: SIAM equation (3.2) and stability argument following Theorem 4.9

remaining_branches: Full Micallef fixed-complex-subspace argument, Atiyah bundle classification, and Fraser-Schoen's quantitative filtration/metric estimates remain cited research inputs.
The complete curved complex second-variation derivation and Koszul-Malgrange local existence are cited, not reconstructed.
The high-genus counterexample construction and Micallef-Moore negative-subspace construction are not reproduced.
The systole theorem's full intrinsic-distance estimates, branched minimal-map existence and fundamental-group argument are not reconstructed.

Report §2 codimension-one developments reuse 2G rather than duplicate Jacobi/second-variation foundations. Stable Bernstein is recorded for complete two-sided hypersurfaces in ambient R^n, n<=6; the R^7 no-growth problem is open in the report, while graphical Bernstein has ambient n<=8.

The question of replacing genus-one cover stability by ordinary stability remains a report question. The stable PIC disk-radius conjecture 4.13 stays in the outline as a conjecture, not a new theorem.
Free-boundary stability, Ricci-flow classification, and other broader classification branches are not developed.

terminology.normal_signs: 2G03 uses scalar A=<nabla nu,tangent>, H=div nu; 2E01 and 2L01 use vector B=(nabla_X du(Y))^perp, Hvector=-H nu in codimension one.
terminology.complex_pairings: b is complex bilinear; h(v,w)=b(v,bar w) is first-variable linear throughout 2L. 2L0K links 2L03 rather than the differently normalized convention of 004N.
terminology.isotropic: 各向同性 refers to a complex symmetric-bilinear null condition, distinguished from contact/symplectic isotropy.
terminology.stability: 覆盖稳定 means stability on every finite cover; boundary tests here are internally compactly supported/fixed-boundary, not free-boundary.
terminology.systole: 最短不可缩闭路长度; measured in the induced metric, not diameter or an ambient geodesic representative.
terminology.degree: 紧 Riemann 曲面上的全纯线丛沿用亚纯截面的零极点次数定义; 0B60 is linked with this analytic extension stated locally.
terminology.rank: 秩二自由阿贝尔群, not 二阶自由阿贝尔群.

reports.speaker: Robert Haslhofer
reports.outline_title: 平均曲率流如何穿过奇点
reports.title: Mean Curvature Flow through Singularities
reports.copyright: 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM
reports.question: 弱流如何延拓穿过奇点，放大模型何时具有重数一、凸性与分类，局部模型又怎样决定唯一性？
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete mathematical text of arXiv:2510.01355v1 sections 1–5, PDF pp.1–18, and its references pp.19–22. Checked official SIAM title, author, DOI, pp.160–178, publication date, license, sections 1–2 and selected statements in sections 4–5. Supplemental primary reading was restricted to the exact definition/theorem passages recorded in actual_reading, not full proofs of every cited research result.

proof_scope.2M01: Definition with outward normal, unaveraged trace, and explicit distinction from convexity.
proof_scope.2M02: Full first-contact barrier proof after citing the curvature evolution identity from section 2.1; the evolution identity itself is not rederived.
proof_scope.2M03: Definition; sphere constant and dilation invariance calculated directly.
proof_scope.2M04: Both ball-center expansions and the connected-ball side argument are proved.
proof_scope.2M05: Andrews preservation theorem cited, with the role of the two-point maximum principle explained, not proved.
proof_scope.2M06: Time-interval expansion and invariance under parabolic scaling are calculated; convergence is not inferred from scaling alone.
proof_scope.2M07: Pointwise nonnegative principal curvature is deduced from HK Theorem 1.10. Global convexity and improvement to constant 1 remain cited results. Uses full-space smooth closed-domain Andrews flows, not arbitrary complete immersed flows.
proof_scope.2M08: Weak set-flow definition includes closed spacetime track and all compact smooth test flows.
proof_scope.2M09: Maximality gives uniqueness; similarity covariance proved using a bijection of competitors. Existence, semigroup, containment and smooth consistency are cited.
proof_scope.2M0A: Spacetime-boundary definition; positive-time ambient relative boundary and initial slice distinguished.
proof_scope.2M0B: Fattening and discrepancy defined; equality of first times and conical examples cited for closed embedded surfaces in R3.
proof_scope.2M0C: Integer rectifiable measure and associated varifold defined; tangent-plane representation uses rectifiability theory.
proof_scope.2M0D: Integral-in-time Brakke inequality with local area and square-integrable generalized curvature assumptions.
proof_scope.2M0E: Weighted transport identity proved from the existing area-density variation and the chain rule.
proof_scope.2M0F: Sudden disappearance of a plane verified directly in the time-integrated inequality.
proof_scope.2M0G: Density and two-sided unit regularity defined; existence of density uses the cited weak monotonicity theory.
proof_scope.2M0H: Mod-2 cyclicity defined using separate flat-chain note; odd triple junction example explained.
proof_scope.2M0I: Measure scaling and fixed/moving center distinction explicit. Compactness, Brakke realization and passage to equality in weak monotonicity remain external inputs.
proof_scope.2M0J: Multiplicity-one theorem cited only for appropriate outer/inner flows from closed embedded surfaces in R3; arbitrary Brakke counterexample included.
proof_scope.2M0K: Multiplicity-one cylindrical tangent-flow uniqueness, including axis uniqueness, cited; no assertion for arbitrary tangents.
proof_scope.2M0L: Ancient asymptotically (n,k)-cylindrical definition; k=0 allowed, and cyclicity separately required for the older R3 classification.
proof_scope.2M0M: Translator graph equation, radial ODE and tip second derivative calculated. Entire bowl existence/uniqueness cited.
proof_scope.2M0N: Standard 2-dimensional ancient oval defined by cited existence/uniqueness; asymptotic descriptions cited.
proof_scope.2M0O: CHH classification cited specifically for n=2,k=1 with unit regularity and cyclicity; proof outline only, no nonlinear estimates claimed.
proof_scope.2M0P: Mean-convex neighborhood and localized nonfattening cited. Local comparison is relative to the small spatial ball, not global nesting.
proof_scope.2M0Q: Deduction of nonfattening for embedded 2-spheres using cited multiplicity one, genus control, shrinker classification, regularity and mean-convex neighborhoods.
proof_scope.2M0R: Exact arbitrarily-small-C-infinity-graph perturbation statement checked against primary Theorem 1.1 and Remark 1; no proof of density drop reproduced.
proof_scope.2M0S: Complete report Theorem 4.1 model list with noncollapsing hypothesis; model families identified by their original constructions rather than symmetry alone.
proof_scope.2M0T: All four positive and three zero modes computed explicitly; full spectral exclusion uses cited Hermite-Fourier completeness, and the nonlinear classification remains external.
proof_scope.2M0U: Report normal form and fast/slow/mixed classification cited; ranks of displayed quadratic forms explained, not a proof of quantization.
proof_scope.2M0V: Canonical-neighborhood contradiction argument written after citing mean-convex compactness/noncollapsing and ancient classification.
proof_scope.2M0W: Report Problem 5.1 and conditional implications to tangent uniqueness/diameter recorded; not presented as solved.
proof_scope.2M0X: Parabolic Hausdorff dimension bound cited; time-direction dimension calculation given. Isolation/shrinking-tube questions distinguished from the bound.
proof_scope.2M0Y: Report formulations of high-dimensional multiplicity-one and genericity conjectures, distinguished from the later local cylindrical theorem.
proof_scope.2M0Z: Bamler-Lai v1 Theorem 1.11 cited with unit regularity, multiplicity-one (n,k)-cylinder, arrival-time formula and k-prime bound. Supplemental proof not reproduced.
proof_scope.2M10: Fixed-flow realization problem distinguished from varying initial data; cited ancient-oval/spherical-accumulation criterion, not its proof.
proof_scope.2M11: Conical selection problem and proposed vanishing-noise idea, without claiming a selection theorem.
proof_scope.2M12: Polyhedral flat-chain definition and continuity of boundary proved; norm nondegeneracy and rectifiable representation cited as GMT inputs.
proof_scope.2M13: Generalized mean curvature defined by absolutely continuous first variation; no singular boundary term silently discarded.
proof_scope.2M14: Translator equation equivalent to translated smooth flow by direct normal-velocity computation.

remaining_branches: The report's epsilon-regularity theorem, general Brakke compactness, elliptic regularization and noncompact weak Huisken monotonicity are cited inputs, not reconstructed proofs.

Full proofs of Andrews noncollapsing, sharp inscribed-radius improvement, genus monotonicity, Brendle genus-zero shrinker classification, Bamler-Kleiner multiplicity one, CM tangent uniqueness and CHH classification remain external.

The six-paper R4 classification program, construction and parameterization of HIMW translators and Du-Haslhofer ovals, differential neck estimates, and Hermite-Fourier completeness are not reconstructed.
Report Problem 5.7 (a mean-curvature-flow proof of the Smale conjecture), Problem 5.9 (immersed flows), and Ricci-flow Conjectures 5.15–5.17 were read but not expanded into new branches.

Higher-dimensional full ancient classification and convexity questions 5.13–5.14 require contextual updates beyond the specifically checked Bamler-Lai statements; no exhaustive 2026 literature audit is claimed.
Only the selected Bamler-Lai definition and theorem sections were read; its 59-page proof and prequel are not claimed fully audited.

reports.speaker: David Witt Nyström
reports.title: Two Calabi–Yau Theorems for Degenerations of Compact Kähler Manifolds
reports.copyright: 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM
reports.question: 固定紧 Kähler 类的退化能否实现任意分支体积分配，以及这种有限维存在性如何连接到非阿基米德有限能量 Monge–Ampère 同胚？
reports.reading_scope: Read all mathematical sections 1–7 and bibliography of arXiv:2510.03044v1, PDF pp.1–19, not merely the abstract; compared SIAM official HTML sections 1–7, exact Theorems A/B, theorem-number changes, and licensing metadata. Also read arXiv:2509.09442v1 introduction sections 1.1–1.5, section 4.1–4.2, section 6 including its proofs, and sections 8.2–8.3. The latter paper was not read in full. Only primary sources are used.

proof_scope.2N01: Definition of real (1,1) classes and smooth potentials; dd^c lemma cited, not proved. Normalization dd^c=i/pi partial barpartial matches existing 0K13.
proof_scope.2N02: Direct proof by the difference-of-powers identity and Stokes; total volume uses omega^n, not omega^n/n!.
proof_scope.2N03: Direct integration-by-parts proof, including the sign and positivity of du wedge d^c u; connectedness and supremum normalization retained.
proof_scope.2N04: Precise smooth positive-volume theorem; existence attributed to Yau, uniqueness linked to 2N03.
proof_scope.2N05: Current, test topology and strong positivity defined; integration-current example. General singular psh definition separated into 2N0Y.
proof_scope.2N06: Big class definition and elementary equivalence with Kahler plus pseudoeffective; convexity proved using currents. Closedness/interior facts cited.
proof_scope.2N07: Envelope minimal-singularity comparison proved after citing the psh upper-envelope theorem; boundedness characterization in a Kahler class derived.
proof_scope.2N08: Lelong numbers defined locally and for classes; logarithmic example calculated. No regularization theorem proved.
proof_scope.2N09: Non-pluripolar truncation construction explained; Bedford–Taylor products, local finiteness, gluing and independence for minimal singularities are external analytic inputs.
proof_scope.2N0A: Restricted volume definition with all three locus cases; restriction bound quoted from report section 5.8; no full restricted-volume theory claimed.
proof_scope.2N0B: Divisorial derivative and linear-relations corollary stated as separate cited analytic results, not a formal deduction of linearity from directional derivatives. Kahler polynomial special case calculated.
proof_scope.2N0C: Smooth compact SNC dominating model with lifted C* action, vertical real divisors, and A=pi_X^*alpha defined; general Kahler construction not replaced by Fano algebraic 0BF7.
proof_scope.2N0D: Model mass formula and total mass one proved by homologous fibres; all multiplicities b_i retained.
proof_scope.2N0E: Product model binomial calculation: F^2=0, A^(n+1)=0, (A+cF)^(n+1)=(n+1)cV, fixed Dirac measure.
proof_scope.2N0F: Big test-configuration measure defined through restricted volumes; mass-one property is a consequence link, not a prerequisite of the definition.
proof_scope.2N0G: Theorem 3.4 and Proposition 6.1 cited with proof outline. Corrected negative-perturbation mass algebra is explicit; continuity, good perturbations and restriction estimates remain analytic inputs.
proof_scope.2N0H: Self-contained finite-dimensional surjectivity argument: Sperner parity by induction, shrinking barycentric subdivisions, compact subsequence limit, coordinate-sum equality, boundary approximation. N=1 handled separately. No use of a radial retraction at a possibly boundary missing point.
proof_scope.2N0I: Theorem A with all fixed-model hypotheses. Finite-dimensional deduction proved from analytic mass/continuity and geometric divisor construction: convexity of actual restricted classes, face preservation, then 2N0H. Does not claim uniqueness of D.
proof_scope.2N0J: Analytic coherent ideal sheaf definition given locally, not substituted by algebraic Noether scheme page; Oka coherence cited for operations.
proof_scope.2N0K: Tropical analytification and semivaluation operations defined; compact Hausdorff theorem cited.
proof_scope.2N0L: Local ideal vanishing-order calculation proves semivaluation identities and explains division by b_i; density of divisorial points cited.
proof_scope.2N0M: Normalized skeleton simplex uses sum b_i w_i=1. Monomial normalization and two-weight endpoint examples calculated; no inverse-limit theorem reconstructed.
proof_scope.2N0N: PL function via divisor coefficients on dominating models; continuous extension and model independence cited. Central fibre gives the constant one.
proof_scope.2N0O: Relative Kahler model potentials and decreasing-net psh limits defined. Nets used because analytification need not be metrizable.
proof_scope.2N0P: Finite energy potentials and the precise strong topology defined; quotient normalization is supremum zero.
proof_scope.2N0Q: Dual energy and strong measure topology defined; weak convergence alone is not asserted sufficient.
proof_scope.2N0R: Model MA measure defined and probability property reduced to 2N0D after central-fibre translation; extension to E1 and continuity cited.
proof_scope.2N0S: Model first derivative explicitly expanded and identified with integral against MA, retaining b_i cancellation. Constant shift energy and MA invariance proved for models and transported via definitions/extension.
proof_scope.2N0T: Theorem B precisely stated as a homeomorphism in two strong topologies. Algebraic Boucksom–Jonsson result distinguished from general Kahler Mesquita-Piccione–Witt Nystrom extension. Section 6 summarized as a proof outline, not a complete analytic proof.
proof_scope.2N0U: Envelope definition plus directly proved 1-Lipschitz stability; continuity and psh property are explicitly external Theorem 1.4.1.
proof_scope.2N0V: Orthogonality deduction fully written conditional on model envelope MA formula, one-sided Lelong estimate, PL uniform density and uniform-potential MA continuity. Uniform/weak integral passage estimated explicitly. Does not claim to prove the two-sided equality in report Proposition 7.4.
proof_scope.2N0W: Divisorial-measure solution derived from A and the model envelope formula; normalized uniqueness cited from B, no uniqueness of divisor claimed.
proof_scope.2N0X: Graph-distance polynomial and sign of restrictions derived. Connectedness of modification fibres and bigness of pullback of a Kahler class are cited geometric inputs. Actual finite-t classes, not limiting gamma vectors, used for convexity.
proof_scope.2N0Y: Psh and theta-psh functions defined separately from currents, including upper semicontinuity, local potentials and canonical representative; basic local integrability/positive-current characterization cited.
proof_scope.2N0Z: Pseudoeffective classes separated from big classes; positive-current convexity explained, closedness cited.
proof_scope.2N10: Analytic singularity definition with bounded remainder as in the report, and a local logarithmic example.
proof_scope.2N11: Non-Kahler/non-nef loci and good hypersurface convention separated from Lelong numbers; elementary locus inclusion proved.

remaining_branches: Yau existence estimates and complete classical finite-energy pluripotential theory remain cited inputs.
Bedford–Taylor/BEGZ non-pluripolar product construction, regularization, restricted-volume approximation, and full proof of divisorial volume differentiability are not reconstructed.
Report Theorem 3.4/Proposition 6.1 good-perturbation and continuity arguments are outlined, with corrected displayed algebra, not promoted to self-contained proofs.
Tropical analytification compactness, inverse-limit theorem, model independence and density are external constructions; no independent proof of the whole non-Archimedean theory.
Envelope continuity, model-envelope measure identity, Lelong regularization bound, finite-energy compactness and strong metric estimates remain external inputs.
Full cscK/YTD applications, valuative beta-invariant, general nontrivially valued fields, and conjectural full transcendental cone duality are outside this packet.
The arXiv v1 blow-up obstruction example has inconsistent ambient dimension notation; it is not imported. The elementary zero-mass obstruction is used instead.
Root registration, whole-site build, rendered/browser QA and independent final acceptance are assigned to parent.
